(2) For template-based modelling of a V/A-ATPase A-subunit bulge, use b.84.5 members (3a5c, 3gqb, 3j9t, 1vdz, 3ikj) rather than lipoyl-domain templates, since fold-level similarity alone does not guarantee alignable cores or conserved loop geometry. (3) The superfamily is a recent manual curation (high sunids 310577/310616/310706/310707) with one family and few species; its boundaries (e.g. A:113-184 in 3a5c versus A:135-212 in yeast 3j9t) and its separate status could be revised if future sequence-profile or structure evidence linked it to another b.84 superfamily. (4) Hit-based evidence (sequence or FATCAT) to other b.84 domains would be candidate evidence only and would not by itself overturn the curated separate-superfamily decision.
